Enum Class SgroupType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<SgroupType>
org.openscience.cdk.sgroup.SgroupType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<SgroupType>, Constable
public enum SgroupType extends Enum<SgroupType>
Enumeration of Ctab Sgroup types.
Display shortcuts
  • SUP, abbreviation Sgroup (formerly called superatom)
  • MUL, multiple group
  • GEN, generic
Polymers
  • SRU, SRU type
  • MON, monomer
  • MER, Mer type
  • COP, copolymer
  • CRO, crosslink
  • MOD, modification
  • GRA, graft
  • ANY, any polymer
Components, Mixtures, and formulations
  • COM, component
  • MIX, mixture
  • FOR, formulation
Non-chemical
  • DAT, data Sgroup
Extensions (things we store as Sgroups but aren't 'MDL' sgroups)
  • Multicenter Bonds
  • Attach Ordering
